cpu_scope: entire experiment process including Java harness and Rust; single-core equivalent
memory_scope: Debug.getPss KiB, actual endpoints and raw samples
goodput_scope: serialized echo request payload bytes divided by device elapsed time; each direction, not sum and not maximum bandwidth
energy_scope: whole device, no matched VPN-off control; incremental EasyTier energy unverified
sampling_limit: nominal 30 s, actual sleeps under device suspension; no interpolation; observed conditions stable at recorded samples only
empty_cells: not measured or not applicable, never substituted with zero
